sources.title: Decret n°95-035 du 24 fevrier 1995 portant organisation des baccalaureats de l'enseignement secondaire (Cameroon; the four mentions; read by OCR)

verification.notes: Draft, not reviewed by an officer of the Ministry. The circulars are for the school year 2023-2024 and were read from scanned images by OCR; they are reissued each year, so the current year's circulars must be checked. Read and modelled: the annual moyenne is (T1 + 2 x T2 + 2 x T3) / 5; religious instruction and manual work are left out of the moyennes; the conduct mark counts with coefficient 1; a first-cycle or second-cycle learner who has not repeated is admitted from an annual moyenne of 10 on 20. Open items: (1) the subject coefficients of circular 270 are in a scanned table the OCR could not read, so every subject's coefficient is 1, a neutral default the school must replace from the Ministry's table (overridable). (2) The mention bands (Passable from 10, Assez bien from 12, Bien from 14, Tres bien from 16) are the wording of the Cameroon decree on the baccalaureates; no Ivorian text was found that states mentions, so they are a draft here. (3) The council's 9.50 to 9.99 advice, the 8.50 to 9.49 repetition, the exclusion below 8.50, the rules for repeaters, the 2nde C to 1re C condition and the series-specific subjects are in the circular but not modelled: the pack suggests promotion from 10 and leaves the rest to the class council. (4) How a subject's trimestre mark is composed from compositions and devoirs follows the rhythm tables of circular 274, which were not read: the pack takes one mark out of 20 per subject. (5) Series (A1, A2, C, D) and their coefficients are not modelled. (6) Primary education (CEPE) is not modelled. (7) Trimestre dates are typical, not gazetted. (8) The moyenne kept to two places and rounded half-up is an assumption. (9) The English labels are a translation of the French; the French labels are drafts no native speaker has reviewed.
